summary: Hinojosa's documented record centers on defending pro-Palestine campus protest and criticizing state police response. In April 2024 she described UT Austin demonstrations as 'respectful debate between pro-Israel & pro-Palestinian students' while faulting police for inflaming emotions; by April 2026 she called Governor Abbott's deployment of DPS troopers 'authoritarian brutality' and accused him of 'hijacking' higher education. Vote for Peace rates her an Ally in the general phase.
